title: Phi-4 joins the chat models
summary:
Phi-4 joined the chat models, while community contributions made ComfyUI integration and a Chinese-language DeepSeek tutorial easier to find.

Added Phi-4 Multimodal Instruct as the `phi` chat model. The same PR moved `llama` to Portkey routing and added routing configurations for several existing models.

Added 1038lab’s ComfyUI-Pollinations node to the README and website SDK and library lists. The node uses the Pollinations API to generate images and text from prompts across multiple models.

Added isinry’s tutorial on giving a DeepSeek chat UI image generation through the Pollinations API to the README and website tutorial lists.

highlights.title: Phi-4 joins chat
highlights.text: Use `phi` to chat with Phi-4 Multimodal Instruct. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=phi).
